objective: Build a general reliable software installation pipeline covering shared artifact publication, conflict-aware scheduling, transactional recovery, and failed-item retry.
boundaries: Local code, focused tests, and local phase commits only. Do not push or release.
Validation is limited to crash evidence and one concrete result of the active change. No full suites or unrelated regression runs.
Do not hide faults by disabling concurrency or adding software/device special cases.

lastValidation.name: failed item exposes only its valid retry route
lastValidation.summary: Only a currently failed concrete resource projects a retry target; standalone failures reinstall only themselves while queued failures resume from their original plan position.
